reason: Rejected: 3 measurements per binary; sum of fixture medians 9981.6832 -> 9910.0980 ms (0.7172% observed gain). Below the registered 2% aggregate gate; no reproducible aggregate benefit established. Exact complete-state fingerprints, exploitability bits and stopping iterations match on all three compressed fixtures. F32 storage and broader correctness suites were not run because the performance screen failed. Timing spread is reported; no statistical significance or production deployment is claimed.

measurement_boundaries.cargo_compilation: Excluded from every run by the fixed evaluator; no Cargo build cost subtracted selectively
measurement_boundaries.runtime_nvrtc_jit: Included in every init_ms/full_cycle_ms, including warm-cache qualification; no runtime compile cost subtracted
measurement_boundaries.cold_start_limit: Warm-cache cohort does not qualify first-use/cold-start performance; separately retained initial runs disclose potential cache/compiler costs. Cache temperature was not experimentally reset or proved identical.
measurement_boundaries.other_exclusions: Correctness fingerprint hashing, HTTP and disk saving; not part of the fixed complete-cycle score
